correctness.rationale: The face condition is exactly support size at most n-2. Signed trace on oriented invariant simplices equals minus a pair-orbit alternating sum. Boolean Möbius inversion over all ground-point permutation cycles gives a(S)=(-1)^|S|(1-f_S). Excluding full support and one omitted fixed point yields reduced Lefschetz sign(g)*(f^2-3f+1) after the top-degree Hopf sign. Published arXiv:1802.05848v1 Theorem 1.3 gives homology concentration, and known permutation-module character identities give precisely the two Specht constituents. Standalone exact verifier checks 38 conjugacy-class instances and separate brute signed-face enumerations for n=4..6. This is a proof for all n>=4, not inference from finite samples.

originality.rationale: The source theorem on all two-subset Kneser neighborhood complexes gives their nonequivariant sphere-wedge types but not their permutation representations. The closest published six-point result fully computes n=6 and was read in full; its n=6 character is implied by and agrees with the present general theorem, but the source confines its conclusion to that n. The new theorem proves an all-n Specht decomposition using a uniform exact signed-support Möbius identity, not finite extrapolation. Searches of indexed results and primary mathematical literature did not identify a general covering representation classification. Distinct wording/unindexed results remain a risk.

value.rationale: The result is a complete, all-n, degree-separated full S_n rational representation classification for a canonical family linked to Lovasz neighborhood topology. The explicit decomposition into two irreducibles (after sign twist), the fixed-point/parity-only character formula and vanishing of invariants are not recoverable from the nonequivariant wedge count. The single previously published n=6 representation is acknowledged and the infinite-family structural identity requires an original exact Möbius argument, not a routine numeric increment.
